//stt: The default is a transcription API, so the container stays small and the
server does no inference. Your recordings are uploaded to the provider.
Groq:   { provider: openai-compatible, url: https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, model: whisper-large-v3, apiKeyEnv: GROQ_API_KEY }
OpenAI: { provider: openai-compatible, url: https://api.openai.com/v1,      model: whisper-1,         apiKeyEnv: OPENAI_API_KEY }
Sarvam: { provider: sarvam, model: saaras:v3, language: unknown, apiKeyEnv: SARVAM_API_KEY }
Indian languages and code-mixed speech; language may be hi-IN, en-IN, ta-IN, … or unknown.
